historical_record.description: A permit was sought for a three-storey frame apartment building, estimated at $25,000. Carl Geilfuss was named as architect.

Sold for $90,000, deed recorded October 27, 1970. The Redevelopment Agency's appraisers, filing it as a comparable sale, described four-story, 22-unit Victorian apartment house (operated as twenty two-room units and one four-room unit), stucco exterior, recessed marble entrance.
